info.name: Birdle - Rooms API
info.description:
Postman collection for testing the Rooms API endpoints of the Birdle Rent Management system.

**Base URL:** `https://monkfish-app-a3cq3.ondigitalocean.app/rent-management/api`

**Auth:** Most endpoints require a Bearer token obtained from the Login endpoint. The collection uses a `token` variable that gets auto-set after login.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints. Login first to obtain a Bearer token for subsequent requests.

request.description:
Fetch all rooms.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "$id": "room_001",
      "building_id": "Central Square Tower",
      "room_number": "101",
      "floor": "1",
      "type": "Studio",
      "monthly_rent": 1800.00,
      "size": 450.00,
      "amenities": "AC, WiFi, Furnished",
      "status": "occupied"
    }
  ]
}
```

Fetch a single room by its ID.

**Path Variables:**
- `room_id`: The room ID (e.g., `room_001`)

request.description:
Create a new room.

**Request Body:**
- `building_id` (string, optional) — Building name or ID
- `room_number` (string, required) — Room number/identifier
- `floor` (string, required) — Floor level
- `type` (string, required) — Room type (Studio, 1-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom, Penthouse)
- `monthly_rent` (number, required) — Monthly rent amount
- `size` (number, required) — Room size in sq ft
- `amenities` (string, optional) — Comma-separated amenities
- `status` (string, required) — `available` or `occupied`

request.description:
Fetch tenants filtered by room ID. Used to find which tenant occupies a given room.

**Query Parameters:**
- `room_id` (string, required) — Filter tenants by room

Fetch all tenants. Supports optional query parameters:
- `status` — Filter by status (active, inactive, moved_out)
- `room_id` — Filter by room ID
- `limit` — Pagination limit (default 25)

Fetch a tenant along with their rent payment transactions. Used to calculate pending rent.

**Path Variables:**
- `tenant_id`: The tenant ID (e.g., `tenant_001`)
